messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up: NebulaOps dedicated pool go-live scheduled next Thu 09:00 UTC. We need final quota, autoscale profile, and a short load sweep. Who can own traffic scripts?

jake_ops: I can take quota + infra sizing. Recommend step-based autoscale for first 48h with conservative cooldowns.

rina_eng: Agree on step-based. Also want a 5m KV prime to avoid cold-cache tails. Ask customer for common prompt prefixes to pre-cache.

maria_cs: rina, can you draft the priming script? jake, post a step plan. I'll collect the customer's traffic heatmap today.

jake_ops: Draft autoscale (v0): {reserved_rps:250, steps:[{add:150,cooldown:3m,sustain:10m},{add:300,cooldown:6m,sustain:20m}], burst_pct:15, headroom_target_pct:30}. Will convert to infra config.

devon_sre: I'll wire temporary alerts: P95/P99, GPU mem pressure, request queue depth. Pager if P99 > 1200ms for 5m.

maria_cs: Can we do a Wed preflight 30m at 08:30 UTC? jake, can you spin a shadow pool?

jake_ops: Wed 08:30 works. Plan: 5m KV prime, 10m at 50% planned load, then ramp to 100% for 15m. I'll spin shadow pool and post job id.

rina_eng: k6 example: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m nebula-sweep.js`. Include a small set of long-context prompts to hit KV misses.

maria_cs: Risk: if latency >10% in week 1, mark renewal risk and run fallback. I'll add mitigation steps to the ticket.

devon_sre: Rollback plan (draft): shift 30% traffic to hosted for 20m, drop to fallback model variant, scale down pool, re-evaluate. I'll write runbook bullets.

support-bot: Scheduled: smoke-pool spin-up 2026-04-15T08:15:00Z (job: smoke-3345129999).

jake_ops: Pushed autoscale JSON to infra repo: repo/internal/autoscale/nebulaops_v0.json.

rina_eng: Uploaded priming script + preflight checklist to the shared folder.

maria_cs: Thanks team. Final sign-off after Wed preflight. :thumbsup:
